meta.ranking: Recommended bets are the props that pass every bet rule, ordered by calibrated edge (the model keeps the highest calibrated edge when a cap binds). Watchlist = live-watch spots, ordered by the size of the 25D score. Leans and passes are ordered by calibrated edge.
rules: 25D score above +1.5 for an over or at most -1.5 for an under (anytime TD and kickers: top or bottom 23% of history).
Projection on the bet side of the line (anytime TD has no under).
Play chance of at least 50% from the injury report.
Calibrated edge of at least 5 points over the break-even of the best price.
Projection and line within 50% of each other; a bigger gap is CHECK NEWS, never a bet.
meta.staking: Model sizing: 1 unit flat (1u = 1% of bankroll). 0.5u for QB rushing and prices of +300 or longer. Caps: 1.5u per game, 10u per day, 2 bets per team, 4 of the same prop and side. Live-watch stakes are conditional halftime stakes from the ladder at -115.
